scope: Edges in the existing STRETCH_GT4_AND_WEIGHT_L1_GT1 + 2-core seam set whose James/Twigg endpoint state is exactly ONE_UNKNOWN.
strata: KNOWN_CORE_SEED: the known endpoint received its label directly from at least one safe dense James/Twigg core face
KNOWN_PROPAGATED_ONLY: the known endpoint was unlabeled by core faces and obtained its label only through safe-graph propagation
teacher_policy: Teacher source topology is evaluation-only after strata are frozen.
purpose: Test whether low-precision ONE_UNKNOWN edges are caused by propagated rather than directly observed James/Twigg labels.
